[SWS_CM_10493] Local Access Control Activation
Upstream requirements:
RS_AP_00158
⌈
If
CmModuleInstantiation
.
localComAccessControlEnabled
is defined and
is set to false,
CM
shall perform no local access control, i.e., no access to any service
from a local
Process
shall be restricted because of missing
ComGrant
s. If
CmMod-
uleInstantiation
.
localComAccessControlEnabled
is not defined or is set to
true,
CM
shall perform local access control.
⌋
